My three picks for value under ₹20,000 from one review page (June 2026 launch prices):

Phone	Price	Battery	Display	Camera
Redmi 15 5G	₹14,999	7,000mAh, 33W	6.9″ 144Hz LCD	Not on the page
OPPO K13 5G	₹17,999	7,000mAh, 80W	6.67″ 120Hz AMOLED	Not on the page
Moto G86 Power 5G	₹17,999	6,720mAh, 33W	6.67″ 1.5K 120Hz pOLED	50MP Sony, stabilised
Best on price: Redmi 15 5G. It has the biggest screen and battery for the lowest cost.
Best for charging: OPPO K13 5G. 80W is the fastest of the five and the screen is AMOLED.
Best for screen and camera: Moto G86 Power 5G.

The page's overall #1 was iQOO Z11x 5G at ₹18,999 with a 7,200mAh battery and dust and water protection. I left it out because it costs more and has an LCD screen. The page's cheapest pick was vivo T4x 5G at ₹13,999.

These prices come from a single review page, and it cut off before the camera details for the Redmi and OPPO. Check the current price in a shop before buying.

Plan a 3 day trip to Jaipur for my parents
10:45 PM

Here's a gentle 3-day Jaipur plan for your parents, with early starts and a long midday rest each day:

Day 1, Old city: City Palace and Jantar Mantar in the morning. Take a Hawa Mahal photo stop from a rooftop cafe across the road. In the evening, stroll Johari Bazaar for jewellery and fabrics.
Day 2, Forts: Reach Amer Fort early, before the crowds and heat, and take a jeep up to the entrance to skip the climb. Stop at Jal Mahal for photos. In the evening, go to Nahargarh by car for the sunset view.
Day 3, Easy day: Albert Hall Museum and Birla Mandir in the morning. Shop for juttis and block prints at Bapu Bazaar. End with dinner and folk music at Chokhi Dhani.

Hire a cab with a driver for all three days, so there is little walking and no hunting for rides. Stay near the old city or in C-Scheme. Try dal baati churma and a glass of lassi. Cooler months, October to March, are the best time to go.

Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
10:49 PM

The National Museum in Delhi is open Tue to Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sat and Sun, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays, so it is shut today and opens tomorrow, Tue 27 Oct, 10:00 AM.

Entry is ₹20 for adults and ₹500 for foreign nationals. Students up to class 12 get in free with an ID card.

This comes from the museum's own Plan Your Visit page. Tickets can be booked online at https://www.zoonga.com/national-museum.
